title: ‘नवपल्लव’ मा सङ्गृहीत गीतिरचनामा देशप्रेम {Patriotism in the lyric collection collected in 'Navapallava'}
nepali: ‘नवपल्लव’ वासुदेव त्रिपाठीद्वारा रचित लघु आयामको गीतिसङ्ग्रह हो । साझा प्रकाशनले २०४६सालमा प्रकाशन गरेको विवेच्य गीतसङ्ग्रहमा ९ ओटा गीतहरू मात्र समेटिएका छन् । उच्च कवित्व र सघनगेयताको समागम भएका विश्लेष्य गीतिरचनाहरूको अन्तर्वस्तु देशप्रेम हो । गीतमा अभिव्यञ्जित देशप्रेमकोकथ्यलाई आस्वाद्य बनाउन के कस्तो गीतिकौशलको प्रयोग गरिएको छ भन्ने प्रमुख प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासा र विमर्शमाप्रस्तुत आलेख केन्द्रित छ । रचनाकारको स्वानुभूतिमा प्रतिबिम्बित राष्ट्ररागको संवेग, भाषिक लालित्य रगीतिसौन्दर्यको वस्तुनिष्ठ मूल्याङ्कनका निम्ति विश्लेष्य गीतिरचनाबाटै साक्ष्य र तथ्य सङ्कलन गरिएको छ ।देशभक्तिका गीतको सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणालाई अवलम्बन गरी गीतको वस्तुविधान र गीतिशिल्पको कलात्मकसंयोजन कसरी भएको छ भन्ने समस्याको समाधान खोज्न विवेच्य रचनाहरूको विश्लेषणका निम्ति गीतितत्वलाई आधार बनाइएको छ । हाम्रा वीर पूर्वजको त्याग, हिमाली राष्ट्र नेपालको अनुपम प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्य,नेपाली जातिको स्वाभिमान र स्वतन्त्रता तथा मातृभूमि नेपालप्रतिको उच्च समर्पणमा ‘नवपल्लव’ कागीतिरचनाको राष्ट्रराग अभिव्यञ्जित भएको छ भन्ने प्रस्तुत अध्ययनको निष्कर्ष रहेको छ । {The lyrical element has been made the basis for the analysis of the compositions to find a solution to the problem of how the material of the song and the artistic combination of the lyric art has been found by adopting the theoretical concept of the patriotic song. american_english: 'Navapallava' is a compact lyric collection composed by Basudev Tripathi. In the lyric collection under consideration, published by Sajha Prakashan in 2046 BS, only 9 songs are included. The core content of the analyzed lyrical compositions, which blend high poetic quality and dense melodiousness, is patriotism. The present article focuses on the primary academic inquiry and discussion regarding what kind of lyrical craft has been used to make the theme of patriotism expressed in the songs relishable. For an objective evaluation of the emotion of patriotic passion, linguistic elegance, and lyrical beauty reflected in the author's own experience, evidence and facts were gathered directly from the lyrical compositions under analysis. Adopting the theoretical concept of patriotic songs, lyrical elements were made the basis for analyzing the works under discussion in order to seek a solution to the problem of how their thematic construction and lyrical craft have been artistically combined. The conclusion of the present study is that the patriotic passion of the lyrical compositions in 'Navapallava' is expressed in the sacrifice of our heroic ancestors, the peerless natural beauty of the Himalayan nation of Nepal, the self-respect and freedom of the Nepali people, and deep devotion to the motherland Nepal.

informal_english: 'Navapallava' is a short, compact lyric collection composed by Basudev Tripathi. In the lyric collection under review, put out by Sajha Prakashan in 2046 BS, only 9 songs are included. The core content of the analyzed lyrical compositions, which bring together high poetic quality and rich melody, is straight-up patriotism. The present article centers on the main scholarly question and discussion about what kind of songwriting craft was used to make the theme of patriotism expressed in the songs truly enjoyable. For an objective look at the emotion of patriotic passion, linguistic grace, and lyrical beauty reflected in the author's own experience, evidence and facts were pulled straight from the lyrical compositions under analysis. Adopting the theoretical concept of patriotic songs, lyrical elements were used as the basis for analyzing the works under discussion to figure out how their thematic construction and songwriting craft are artistically combined. The takeaway of this study is that the patriotic passion of the lyrical compositions in 'Navapallava' really shines through the sacrifice of our heroic ancestors, the unmatched natural beauty of the Himalayan nation of Nepal, the pride and freedom of the Nepali people, and deep devotion to the motherland Nepal.
